- Duration: 1 year and 5 months

- Functional Impairment: True

- Additional Requirements:

1) psychotic_symptoms and depressive_episode occur concurrently

2) depressive_episode is present for the majority of the total duration of the active and residual portions of the illness (Criterion C)

3) delusions_and_hallucinations occur for 2 or more weeks in the absence of a major mood episode (Criterion B)
